units.id: phrase:hai festival payment dialog|Luckily your <passengers> didn't cause too much trouble on the trip. After collecting their things, they pay you <payment> and make their way to the festival.|223|0

units.english: Festival at <planet>

units.english: The Hai dockworkers load the food for the Unfettered onto your ship. One of them says to you,
units.italian: Gli scaricatori Hai caricano il cibo per gli Unfettered sulla tua nave. Uno di loro ti dice:

units.id: phrase:unfettered aid pickup dialog|As the Hai load the food onto your ship, one of them says,|338|0
units.english: As the Hai load the food onto your ship, one of them says,
units.italian: Mentre gli Hai caricano il cibo sulla tua nave, uno di loro dice:

units.id: phrase:unfettered aid pickup dialog|"Thank you. This is far better than watching our kinfolk starve."|342|0
units.english: "Thank you. This is far better than watching our kinfolk starve."
units.italian: "Grazie. È molto meglio che vedere i nostri consanguinei morire di fame."

units.id: phrase:unfettered aid pickup dialog|"Tell our brothers and sisters that if they will only repent, they will be welcome to come home."|343|0
units.english: "Tell our brothers and sisters that if they will only repent, they will be welcome to come home."
units.italian: "Dite ai nostri fratelli e sorelle che, se solo si pentiranno, saranno i benvenuti a casa."
